name: The Happiness Initiative & Counseling Cell
description: Professional psychological counselors, student peer mentors, workshops on stress management and academic balance.

name: Student Senate
description: Democratically elected student legislative body representing students across institute policy, academic, and hostel committees.

name: Board of Sports Activities (BSA)
description: Organizes inter-hostel tournaments, annual sports meet (Varchas), and maintains campus athletic infrastructure.

name: Student Activity Centre (SAC) Clubs
description: Music (Rhythm), Dance (Tadka), Drama (Thespians), Robotics, Programming Club (P-Club), and Astronomy Club.

name: Student Grievance Redressal Committee
description: Statutory body addressing academic, administrative, and hostel grievances in a time-bound confidential manner.
